title: Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, AWS & AI Partners
description: MKTQ427R47 Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, AWS & AI Partners Sr. Partner Marketing Manager, AWS & AI partners, will accelerate Databricks’ growth by turning strategic cloud and AI ISV partnerships into measurable demand, pipeline, and customer-adoption outcomes. This role connects partner strategy, joint messaging, campaigns, events, and field execution across AWS and strategic technology partners. Impact You’ll Make Ensure the annual AWS joint marketing plan is delivering against agreed GTM priorities and assigned partner pipeline targets aligned to Databricks’ strategic products, including Genie, Unity Gateway, and Lakebase. AWS Marketing Development Funds (MDF) are deployed through clear investment tiers, approval workflows, vendor governance, and ROI reporting that enables informed re-investment decisions. Databricks’ presence at AWS re:Invent, AWS events, and related programs are producing agreed engagement, demand, and opportunity outcomes through coordinated events, content, demos, and activations. AWS and strategic AI/ISV co-marketing programs are generating net-new demand and supporting active opportunities, with sourced and influenced pipeline traceable through deal registration, SFDC matching, and partner lead tracking. Joint marketing plans, messaging, and customer-use-case campaigns with strategic AI/ISV partners are increasing awareness and creating demand for Databricks solutions. Created content in joint-marketing plans are supported with solution briefs, integration use cases, campaign assets, and customer proof points that are adopted across relevant partner and field teams. Product feature and integration launches with AI/ISV partners, along with at least six customer stories or joint announcements annually, are increasing market proof, partner activation, and customer adoption. Partner marketing motions and communications are scalable across regions, with standardized campaign kits, enablement touchpoints, and engagement or adoption results tracked against agreed targets. What We Look For 7+ years of experience in partner marketing, alliance marketing, or product marketing within enterprise software, cloud, or SaaS companies. Demonstrated experience building and executing joint marketing programs with AWS or comparable cloud and technology partners, with measurable impact on pipeline, opportunities, or revenue. Experience managing MDF, co-op funds, or joint marketing budgets, including investment governance and ROI measurement. Experience translating cloud, data, AI/ML, data engineering, data warehousing, or analytics capabilities into differentiated joint messaging and customer use cases for technical and business audiences. Proven ability to create customer-facing marketing content, including solution briefs, industry use cases, campaign assets, and customer proof points. Strong program-management and cross-functional leadership experience, aligning Product Marketing, Partner Managers, Solution Architects,and Regional Marketing around shared goals. Demonstrated ability to activate partners and customers through conferences, webinars, executive briefings, or other marketing forums using clear storytelling and data. Track record of moving complex programs from strategy to execution in a fast-paced, high-growth environment while measuring progress against business outcomes.
